entries.Kent_like_BeforeMovie: Благодаря за поканата на кино, @. Не е лесно отново да свикна с цивилния живот, но ти ми помогна да се почувствам добре дошъл.

entries.Kent_like_DuringMovie_2: На лицето на Кент се появява рядка усмивка.

entries.Clint_like_DuringMovie: Това е просто... *хълц*... Joja Cola.$h^*шепнешком*... Ако си, ъъ... уморена... можеш да сложиш глава на моето... моето рамо. Хех... или недей!$4

corrections: Translated and reread Strings/MovieReactions source ordinals 133–180 directly from English, covering Sam, Vincent, Kent, Clint, Emily, Haley and the first five Maru film groups.

Preserved every player marker, emotion code, caret-separated gender branch, emphasis asterisk and hesitation, including Kent’s difficult civilian adjustment, Clint’s awkward date dialogue and Emily’s spiritual vocabulary.

Applied locked Joja Cola, Yoba and character names, then refined Clint’s flask denial, Emily’s positive-energy response and Haley’s fantasy question for natural Bulgarian without flattening their voices.
